name: Crumpet Toast
ingredients: INGREDIENTS: WHEAT FLOUR, WATER, CINNAMON PIECES (7%) (INVERT SUGAR, PEAR PUREE CONCENTRATE (PEAR, FOOD ACID (300)), SUGAR, WHEAT FIBRE, HUMECTANT (GLYCEROL), FRUCTOSE, GROUND CINNAMON (3%), GELLING AGENT ((PECTIN), SUCROSE), ACIDITY REGULATOR (270)), WHEAT GLUTEN, SUGAR, CANOLA OIL, RAISING AGENTS (450, 500), BAKER'S YEAST, ACIDITY REGULATOR (263), MOLASSES, VINEGAR, IODISED SALT, SPICES (CINNAMON (0.4%), MIXED SPICES), NATURAL FLAVOUR, SOY FLOUR, EMULSIFIER (481), RICE FLOUR.
storage: STORAGE CONDITIONS: Keeps better in refrigerator. To freeze crumpets, wrap pack in a freezer bag. Store at or below -15°C. Recommended frozen life, 2 months. On thawing consume immediately, do not refreeze.
origin: MADE IN NEW ZEALAND FROM IMPORTED & LOCAL INGREDIENTS
